reasoning: On the season so far the Hornets are the stronger team; with home court the Hornets start about 0 points better, in a game of about 219 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets (look-ahead, revenge).
Bottom line: the Hornets win 57 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 191 and 240 total points.
